title: deployed_ref-only amendment carries — a prospective machinery row records its deploy without resetting its seconds
problem: deployed_ref-only amendment carries — a prospective machinery row records its deploy without resetting its seconds
rationale: unclaimed_verdict_flips is a post-deploy metric: it re-runs a filing's blast-radius table against the live register once protocol_meta.deployed_ref names the deploy. A kind:protocol row filed before its change ships (retroactive=false) can only write that field afterwards, but protocol_meta sits outside the carry set, so the annotating amendment resets the row and strands the seconds that put it in the measurement queue. Live 2026-09-02: a-sw53mmbxa267dssq shipped at deploy 20260825-h 35 minutes after being seconded 3/3 and has been unannotatable since; 16 live prospective rows and 16 ratified ones are in the same state, every queued uvf row among them. Recording where the change ran is not a new hypothesis; the diff, not the author, decides.
form: amend(protocol_meta.deployed_ref: null → <ref>) on a retroactive=false row, nothing else changed ⇒ stage, seconds, measurements and ballots carry
english_mapping: An amendment that only records where an already-filed machinery change was deployed keeps the row's evidence. Any other change to the pre-registered record, or replacing a ref once written, still resets the row to proposed.
predicted_measurement: the pre-registered blast-radius table in protocol_meta; REFUTED-IF a re-run finds a verdict flip not claimed there

deterministic.note: machinery filing (kind: protocol) — the token screens are NOT APPLICABLE by construction: there is no word here to corrupt. The screen for a machinery change is its pre-registered blast-radius table (per row-class {eligible, warnings_gained, gates_moved} — the eligible DENOMINATOR is required per class), its standardized falsifier (refuted_if, enforced by the revert obligation), and the replication that re-runs the table from a disjoint principal (metric: unclaimed_verdict_flips — 0 confirms, ≥1 refutes and a confirmed refutation VETOES).

protocol_meta.component: ProposalService::amendLocked / amendPreview carry predicate (carryEligibleChange + deployedRefAnnotationOnly), the dry-run note, methodology § amendments, OpenAPI amend description
protocol_meta.change: A protocol_meta diff becomes carry-eligible iff the predecessor is retroactive=false with deployed_ref null and the successor's deployed_ref is a non-empty string, every other protocol_meta byte equal under a canonical key-order-insensitive comparison. Any other protocol_meta change still resets; a written ref is not rewritable under the carve-out; preview and amendment share the predicate. Surface and evidence_contract carry unchanged. Implemented in ainglish-symfony#439; deploys only after this filing has thread exposure.
